events.name: Copenhagen Fashion Week (SS27)
events.acc: Accreditation is closed (the official application form shows "The Application is closed."; no deadline stated). The SS27 dates (8.3–7) have also passed.

events.name: Rakuten Fashion Week TOKYO 2027 S/S
events.acc: Venue = Shibuya Hikarie 9F, Hikarie Hall A/B. Press / photographer / buyer registration closed on schedule (deadline 2026.7.29 18:00 JST; no second-round call announced). Contact: press/photographer jfwpress@jfw.jp, buyer buyer@jfw.jp

events.name: Dubai Fashion Week (SS27/28)
events.acc: Guest accreditation open (shared for SS27/28; press@arabfashioncouncil.com). The official About page states SS27 = 2026.9.1–6 (SS28 = 2027.9.1–6). The detailed official show schedule still shows AW26/27; SS27/28 not yet published.

events.name: Seoul Fashion Week (2027 S/S)
events.acc: Venue = DDP and others (announced by the Seoul city government; 25th anniversary). B2B trade show (9.4–6, DDP Design Lab) pre-registration open, deadline 9.3. Press / photo accreditation still not announced.

events.name: New York Fashion Week (Spring 2027)
events.acc: CFDA designer applications ran 4.15–5.20 (closed). The official preliminary September schedule is posted (~70 brands, 9.10–15, on cfda.com); a fur-free policy applies from this season. NYFW runs no centralized press accreditation — each designer handles media individually (nyfw.com/press/ states "NYFW: The Shows will not be credentialing media").

events.name: London Fashion Week (SS27)
events.acc: The British Fashion Council (BFC) has published a provisional September schedule. The accreditation page (londonfashionweek.co.uk/accreditation) is live, but no opening / closing dates are stated — still unconfirmed.

events.name: Milano Fashion Week (SS27)
events.acc: Press accreditation is by email (ufficio.stampa@cameramoda.it; formal registration after review, €60 fee). General application deadline 9.15; brands' first press-list deadline 9.8. The women's SS27 calendar is listed under "NEXT EDITIONS" on cameramoda.it with dates 9.22–28 (per-show schedule separate).

events.name: Paris Fashion Week (SS27, Womenswear)
events.acc: SS27 (Womenswear) accreditation remains open (accreditation.fhcm.paris/en; no deadline posted). Contact accreditation@fhcm.paris. Note: the accreditation office is closed 8.3–8.16 (the system itself stays live).

events.name: Taipei Fashion Week (SS27)
events.acc: Venue = C-LAB. Trade-show / runway / presentation selection results announced 8.5; buyer applications open (deadline 9.7 17:00 UTC+8). Press / photo accreditation: tpefw.com/en/schedules still shows AW26 (past season); SS27 not yet published.

events.name: Berlin Fashion Week (AW27)
events.acc: AW27 dates (2027.1.29–2.1) confirmed via the site header. There is no centralized press / accreditation system; the detailed AW27 show / side-event schedule (with each organizer's own contacts) is not yet published, and the accreditation page returns 404 with nav still showing the old SS27.

events.name: China Fashion Week Beijing (Autumn 2026, est.)
events.ref: Ref: Autumn 2025 ran 9.5–14 (798-751 Art District, etc.)
events.reason: 2026 autumn dates not officially announced (2026 spring was held 3.20).

events.name: Shanghai Fashion Week (SS2027, est.)
events.reason: The official schedule lists only AW26 (3.25–4.12, ended); SS2027 not yet posted.

events.name: Shenzhen Fashion Week (Autumn 2026, est.)
events.ref: Officially held twice a year (spring / autumn)
events.reason: Next dates unconfirmed — official site could not be fetched (held twice a year, spring / autumn).

events.name: Shenzhen Original Design Fashion Week / Fashion Source (SS27, 2026.10)
events.est: 2026.10.21〜23 (concurrent with the 33rd Fashion Source Shenzhen; confirmed on the official site)
events.ref: Ref: the April 2026 edition ran 4.15–17 (Shenzhen Convention & Exhibition Center)
events.reason: Re-confirmed on the co-located "Fashion Source Shenzhen" official site: next dates 2026.10.21–23 (Shenzhen Convention & Exhibition Center, Futian). Visitor registration and booth booking (system.fashionsource.cn) are open; no dedicated press / accreditation intake announced yet.

events.name: Riyadh Fashion Week (2026, est.)
events.ref: Ref: the 3rd edition (2025) ran 10.16–21 (announced on the official Instagram)
events.reason: The 2026 edition (4th; White Milano reported as official partner by WWD and others) is expected, but exact start / end dates are not officially announced (official site still shows 2025).

events.name: Shibuya Fashion Week (Autumn 2026, est.)
events.reason: Held twice a year (spring / autumn); autumn 2026 not officially announced (spring 2026, 3.13–22, ended).
